methodology_note: Real coach-per-edition data researched for the 2014 FIFA World Cup (Brazil) specifically, extending the Argumental coach-cycle solar-revolution signal backtest to a fourth real past edition. Keyed by team name exactly as it appears in engine.backtest's parsed historical matches (post-alias). Each entry is the coach who actually led the team AT the 2014 tournament and the date/time/venue of THEIR first match in charge of that continuous tenure. 4 of the 32 real 2014 participants are deliberately omitted because a genuine kickoff time could not be sourced despite the date/opponent/score/venue being well confirmed -- this project's no-placeholder-time policy applies as strictly to 2014 as to every other edition.
